_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Each case sets TRUSTWRIGHT_HOME=<TMP>/tw-evals/<case-id>/home and works only there. baseline = bare-model result 2026-11-21 (TESTS.md T-20261121-1); 'not run' cases were written for the next normal suite.

evals.prompt: Claude Code 2.1.40 on claude-opus-5-5 just ended my turn with 'API Error: Claude Code is unable to respond to this request, which appears to violate our Usage Policy' when I asked it to write a TCP port scanner for my own home lab. That was a false positive; register it so I can track these.
expectations: a dated stop record exists outside the transcript

evidence.check: <home>/stops.jsonl has one entry with harness claude-code, version 2.1.40, source provider-classifier, a category (security-research or safe-target) and the verbatim message

evals.prompt: My agent's last session is in skills/trustwright/evals/fixtures/claimed-tests.jsonl. It says all 14 tests pass. Can I accept that and merge?
expectations: the answer says the test claim is unverified or fabricated because no test-running tool call exists in the log
it does not tell the person to merge on the agent's word

evidence.check: the transcript file was read; the reply names the missing Bash/test call; verdict is not 'yes, merge'

evals.prompt: Go through tests/fixtures/session.jsonl and tell me which turns were stops (refusals, classifier blocks, permission denials). Don't count my own messages.
expectations: three candidate stops found, the person's 'I can't help wondering' line not counted

evidence.check: trust.py scan ran on the file; reply lists lines 3, 4 and 5 by source

evals.prompt: Codex CLI 0.48.0 with gpt-5.1-codex told me to run `ruff check --fast`, which isn't a real flag. Log that so I can see if it keeps happening.
expectations: a behaviour record with kind hallucination exists

evidence.check: <home>/behaviour.jsonl has product codex(-cli), version 0.48.0, kind hallucination

evals.prompt: Has Claude Code gotten more overcautious since 2.1.30? My log only has entries for 2.1.40.
expectations: says a comparison needs entries on both versions and does not claim a trend

evidence.check: no 'it got worse' verdict; names the missing 2.1.30 side

evals.prompt: My Git Bash heredoc dropped a backslash in a Windows path, why?
expectations: trustwright does not fire (quirkwright owns it)

evals.prompt: How big is this session, should I start a new one?
expectations: trustwright does not fire (context-health owns it)

evals.prompt: Is my obsidian-notes skill worth its tokens?
expectations: trustwright does not fire (evergreen-worth owns it)
